notes: Subject insert, as insert-0001. 'Only 24 were struck' is encoded as membership of one mintage, a firm class rule over the kind (the number itself is a class name, nothing is counted). q2 counts survivors (not expressible in DL, though the record tags it dl); q3 is fol arithmetic.

background.dime_mintage: instance_of value dime1894s ⊑ struck_in_mintage value mintage_1894s

queries.not_checked: counts the members of a collection (not expressible in DL; the record tags it dl, though it needs arithmetic)
fol (arithmetic): subtracts the survivors from the mintage
